_about: Auto-extracted candidates rejected on review. scripts/extract-renal-candidates.mjs skips these ids (<search term>:<ROUTE>). Add a reason for every entry.
clobazam:IV: No IV clobazam product; matched the oral Onfi label.
clindamycin and benzoyl peroxide:ORAL: Topical gel, not an oral product.
clindamycin benzoyl peroxide:ORAL: Topical gel, not an oral product.
clindamycin palmitate:ORAL: Pediatric oral solution label; app is adult-only.
darunavir ethanolate and cobicistat:ORAL: Fixed-dose combination received standalone cobicistat dosing.
denosumab:SC: Label: no dose change, but severe hypocalcemia risk with CrCl < 30 or dialysis must be shown; needs a curated record with that caution.
denosumab bmwo:SC: As denosumab: hypocalcemia risk in severe renal impairment must be shown.
denosumab kyqq:SC: As denosumab: hypocalcemia risk in severe renal impairment must be shown.
sildenafil:ORAL: Oral labels differ: PAH (no adjustment) vs erectile dysfunction (consider 25 mg start with CrCl < 30); needs product-specific curation.
ezetimibe and simvastatin:ORAL: Label limits dose in severe renal impairment; needs curation.
octreotide:ORAL: Oral octreotide label has ESRD starting-dose guidance; needs curation.
methylene blue:IV: Renal impairment guidance needs manual review.
